title: Pierce-bomb server-side parity — node-world-server mirrors the S142 client branch
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-27-002 (priority: should, KABOOM-CREW-MVP-NETWORK). S142 shipped Pierce client-side and explicitly deferred server-side parity to a connected-mode sprint. This story IS that follow-up. Before this lands, connected-mode pierce is a visual desync — Tab A's local sim shows the blast walking through the first soft block, Tab B's authoritative server view stops at it.
Scope = one branch in the server's blast-cell walker + the placement copy (mirror of S142 FEAT-KABOOM-PIERCE-PLACEMENT-001) + parity tests. No protocol changes (snapshot already carries pierce flag).

Bot AI parity — extended the server's bot dodge map + self-bomb-sim escape checks to consume the new pierce flag so a Pierce bomber doesn't trap itself and a bot doesn't path through a pierce extension. Out of scope: stacking pierce, pierce-aware strategic bot scoring.

stories.title: Server PickupKind + ServerBomberStats gain pierce
stories.summary: examples/backends/node-world-server/src/world.ts — PickupKind union adds 'pierce'. PICKUP_KINDS drop table includes 'pierce' (single entry, mirroring S142 ~half-rarity). ServerBomberStats type adds optional `pierce?: boolean`. applyPickupEffect gains the 'pierce' branch: idempotent flip (stats.pierce === true → undefined no-op).
verification: acceptance: PickupKind union + PICKUP_KINDS drop table + ServerBomberStats + applyPickupEffect all carry pierce in examples/backends/node-world-server/src/world.ts. Pickup pierce flips BomberStats.pierce=true; second pickup of same kind is a silent no-op.

stories.title: computeBlastCells gains pierce-budget walker
stories.summary: examples/backends/node-world-server/src/map-loader.ts — `computeBlastCells` signature gets optional `pierce: boolean = false` (back-compat for unrelated call sites). Per-direction implementation tracks `pierceBudget = pierce ? 1 : 0`. On a soft-block hit: include the cell, decrement budget when > 0 + continue; otherwise stop. Hard walls always stop and ARE NOT included. Mirror of S142 blast-propagation-system.ts.
verification: acceptance: computeBlastCells(map, ox, oz, range, true) walks through the first soft block per direction, stops on the second; hard walls always stop; per-direction budget is independent (5 unit tests in tests/unit/node-world-server-map.test.ts).

stories.title: Server placeBomb / placeBombForEntity copy stats.pierce → bomb.pierce
stories.summary: examples/backends/node-world-server/src/world.ts — both `placeBomb(playerId, gx, gz)` (external client API) and `placeBombForEntity(BOT_ENTITY_ID, ...)` (bot AI) read the owner's ServerBomberStats and, when pierce === true, write `bomb.pierce = true` into the Bomb component. Non-pierce owners produce a Bomb without the pierce field (keeps the snapshot lean). The bomb's fuse loop + the chain-detonation loop both read bomb.pierce and pass it to computeBlastCells.
verification: acceptance: placeBomb + placeBombForEntity stamp pierce when ownerStats.pierce === true; fuse-loop computeBlastCells gets bomb.pierce; chain-detonation computeBlastCells gets the chained bomb's own pierce (chained bombs are not retroactively pierced by the trigger).

stories.title: Server bot AI dodge map + escape sims respect pierce
stories.summary: examples/backends/node-world-server/src/world.ts — computeBlastDangerCells reads bomb.pierce off each active bomb so a Pierce bomb's extension cell is treated as dangerous. botHasTwoStepEscape + hasSafeEscape read the bot's own BomberStats.pierce so the simulated bomb in the escape-route projection matches the bomb that would actually be placed. Out of scope: pierce-aware strategic scoring (carried-over from GDP-2026-05-26-002).
verification: acceptance: dangerCells + 2-step escape + coward-escape sims all pass pierce through computeBlastCells. Existing bot-survival tests stay green (no regressions: bot survives ≥10s solo, hunter chases, miner picks up pickups).

stories.title: Pierce parity tests — walker + placement + propagation
stories.summary: tests/unit/node-world-server-map.test.ts — adds two describe blocks: 'computeBlastCells pierce (S147)' covers the 3 GDP scenarios (pierce + 1 soft per dir, pierce + 2 softs blocks at second, pierce + hard wall always stops, pierce budget per-direction, pierce=false control) + 'ServerWorld pierce pickup + placement (S147)' covers BomberStats flip, bomb stamping, BlastEvent.cells include the extension, control case without pierce, owner-loses-pierce contract.
verification: acceptance: 12 new tests in tests/unit/node-world-server-map.test.ts (5 walker + 5 ServerWorld + 2 control). Existing 100+ tests in the file remain green. npm run typecheck + npm run test stay green.
